gloss: to boast, to be proud of, to take pride in

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {誇|ほこ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be proud of, to take pride in
definitions.explanation: To feel pride in something, often a legitimate accomplishment, quality, or tradition. In this sense, the nuance is positive — having justified confidence or pride.
To speak proudly or show off about one's achievements or possessions. In this sense, the nuance can be negative, implying excessive self-promotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{誇|ほこ}る⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's technology that Japan is proud of.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誇|ほこ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This region boasts a long history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誇|ほこ}れる⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}りたい→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to make products of a quality we can be proud of to the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誇|ほこ}る。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誇|ほこ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He's always boasting about his educational background.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{栄光|えいこう}→栄光：20495_eikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誇|ほこ}って⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{進|すす}めない→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: If you just keep boasting about past glories, you can't move forward.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誇|ほこ}る: to be proud of ~, to boast ~
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誇|ほこ}れる: to be able to be proud of (toward ~)
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誇|ほこ}る: to be proud of on a world stage

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誇|ほこ}る: to boast a history
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誇|ほこ}る: to take pride in tradition
- ⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誇|ほこ}る: to boast achievements
- ⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇り：03623_hokori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧: to feel proud (related noun form)

USAGE:
When the subject is a place, company, or country, sense 1 (legitimate pride) is typical. When the subject is a person showing off, it can shade into sense 2 (boasting). The potential form {誇|ほこ}れる is common in positive contexts: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誇|ほこ}れる (something to be proud of internationally).
